contexts.text: The dumb (one of the classes of the neighbour in the Ancient Church).
who hath made the dumb? () = no utterance.

In the internal sense, dumb = those who are not able to confess the Lord, thus neither to preach faith in Him, from ignorance; in which state are the gentiles outside the Church, and also the simple within the Church. Illustrated.
Then shall the tongue of the dumb sing () = that they will confess the Lord and the things which are of faith in Him.
The dumb who were healed by the Lord, also = the gentiles who, by His Advent into the world, were delivered from falsities and consequently from evils. AC 7337.
Those within the Church who have denied the Lord... at last either become as if they were dumb, or speak sillily.

They who, from profanation of this kind, have confirmed themselves against the Divine and against the Word, sit dumb in that darkness, unable to speak, wanting to prate about pious and holy things, as in the world, but unable to do so.
When a hypocrite comes among the wise, he... sits mute.
[151a].[end]. If they have any inclination, it is rendered mute...
Such judges... sit as dumb as statues...
When such are alone... they stand like dumb machines.
A dull pain. SE 1273. SE 1623. SE 4088. SE 4088. SE 4088:end. SE 4419.
He seemed to me to be dumb.
The dumb = those who, from ignorance of the truth, are not able to confess the Lord, or the genuine truths of the Church.
The tongue of the dumb which shall sing = the confession of the Lord by those who are in ignorance of truth.
The Spirit was called deaf and dumb by the Lord () because he did not want to perceive and understand truth.
That there is no intelligence or life there or therefrom, is signified by he maketh dumb gods ().
